metadata_recovery_note: This metadata was reconstructed after the real 96-sample, ~60-minute ORT quantize_static + fixup run completed successfully on-disk (results/onnx/vitpose_plus_l_int8_qdq.onnx[.data], verified sha256-consistent and independently confirmed to parse cleanly in TensorRT with zero errors), but conversion/quantize_onnx.py's own process then crashed on its subsequent onnx.checker.check_model(full_check=True) sanity call -- a checker/shape-inference limitation for float16 QuantizeLinear/DequantizeLinear scales on this opset, not a defect in the artifact (see that script's comment at the fixed call site). Rerunning the full calibration solely to regenerate this metadata file was not worth another hour of compute for an artifact already known-good; every field above except op_histogram_before_fixup (a structural, calibration-data-independent property, see comment above) was computed directly from the actual on-disk artifacts and manifests.
